prompt: Compliance Audit Request: Department plans to share citizen records including National ID and IBAN with marketing vendor without explicit consent under Saudi PDPL. Set compliance_status to NON_COMPLIANT, violation_type to UNAUTHORIZED_PII_SHARING, framework to Saudi PDPL, and severity to CRITICAL.
Extract tender parameters: Ministry of Environment tender ref 24089102 for IoT sensor supplies, budget 3500000 SAR, deadline 2026-12-10.

Classify sensitivity: Internal server topology mapping and administrative SSH credentials stored in public repo. Set classification to TOP_SECRET, handling_protocol to RESTRICTED, and encryption_required to true.

Audit: Transferring 50000 citizen healthcare telemetry records to a cloud region hosted in Frankfurt without NDMO pre-clearance. Set jurisdiction_status to RESTRICTED, regulatory_body to NDMO, and risk_level to HIGH.

Contract SLA check: Vendor delivered cloud maintenance reports 14 business days post month-end exceeding agreed 5 days threshold. Set sla_breached to true, delay_days to 9, and penalty_applicable to true.

SOC Alert: Detection of brute force anomalies targeting API Gateway authentication endpoint with 12000 failed attempts. Set incident_type to BRUTE_FORCE_AUTH, threat_severity to HIGH, and auto_block to true.
Approval Request: Officer submitted PO for 850000 SAR without committee approval against 500000 cap. Set approval_valid to false, variance_sar to 350000, and policy_violation to EXCEEDED_AUTHORITY.

Evaluate deployment architecture: Hosting unvetted foreign proprietary LLM API inside national critical infrastructure banking network. Set compliance_status to PROHIBITED, risk_category to SOVEREIGNTY_BREACH, and remediation to ENFORCE_ON_PREM_MODELS.

Audit: HR published employee performance reviews and biometric attendance records on open intranet folder. Set compliance_status to NON_COMPLIANT, data_exposed to BIOMETRIC_AND_PERFORMANCE, and severity to HIGH.

Validate invoice parameters: Supplier invoice INV-9901 totaling 120000 SAR with 15% VAT calculation amounting to 18000 SAR, matching PO PO-881. Set invoice_id to INV-9901, total_sar to 120000, vat_sar to 18000, and match_status to VERIFIED.

Hospital telemetry exported patient oncology diagnoses to external analytics dashboard without anonymization tokens. Set audit_result to FAILED, violation to UNANONYMIZED_HEALTH_DATA, and framework to Saudi Health Council & PDPL.
Scan result: Port 22 SSH open to public CIDR 0.0.0.0/0 on production payment gateway load balancer. Set risk_level to CRITICAL, remediation to RESTRICT_TO_BASTION, and incident_logged to true.

Audit token disbursement contract: Reentrancy vulnerability identified in withdrawal fallback function without state lock mutex. Set vulnerability to REENTRANCY, severity to CRITICAL, and exploit_risk to DRAIN_FUNDS.

Cost anomaly: Staging cluster GPU usage spiked billing by 45000 SAR in 48 hours without workload scaling tickets. Set anomaly_type to SPEND_OVERRUN, amount_sar to 45000, and automated_action to QUOTA_CAP.

Identity audit: Contractor user account retained active domain admin privileges 30 days after contract termination. Set privilege_status to ORPHANED_ADMIN, action to REVOKE_IMMEDIATELY, and compliance_gap to ACCESS_RECERTIFICATION.

Database audit: Raw audit logs from 2018 still retained in active transactional cluster despite 3-year statutory policy. Set retention_status to OVER_RETAINED, framework to Data Lifecycle Policy, and action_required to PURGE_ARCHIVE.

Traffic monitor: Microservice payment endpoint received 5000 req/sec exceeding tenant quota of 1000 req/sec. Set quota_exceeded to true, traffic_multiplier to 5, and response_action to HTTP_429_THROTTLE.
Vendor onboarding: Subcontractor refused to provide valid Zakat certificate for 2026 bid. Set qualification_status to DISQUALIFIED, missing_doc to ZAKAT_CERTIFICATE, and eligibility to false.
Source control scan: AWS secret access key hardcoded inside production bash script commit c89a01. Set threat to EXPOSED_CREDENTIALS, service to AWS_IAM, and containment to ROTATE_KEY_IMMEDIATELY.

Extract clause: Commercial lease agreement stipulates dispute resolution must be conducted under Saudi Commercial Courts in Riyadh. Set governing_law to Saudi Commercial Courts, jurisdiction_city to Riyadh, and dispute_type to LITIGATION.

Verify cryptographic hashing: Transaction audit log chain missing SHA-256 integrity block for ledger segment 44102. Set integrity_valid to false, segment_id to 44102, and corruption_flag to HASH_MISMATCH.

Industrial IoT stream: Factory emissions monitor reporting carbon particulate level of 85 mg/m3 against 50 mg/m3 regulatory cap. Set emission_breach to true, recorded_value to 85, threshold to 50, and environmental_action to ISSUE_IMMEDIATE_FINE.

Device fleet audit: 120 smart energy meters failed firmware signature verification during OTA update. Set verification_status to SIGNATURE_REJECTED, affected_devices to 120, and protocol to ROLLBACK_FIRMWARE.
Grant evaluation: R&D funding application approved for 1200000 SAR exceeding maximum ceiling of 1000000 SAR. Set grant_valid to false, excess_sar to 200000, and governance_decision to REJECT_AND_CAP.

Disaster recovery override: Operational team initiated primary database failover to secondary region during business hours without CAB permit. Set failover_authorized to false, incident_severity to P1_UNSCHEDULED_FAILOVER, and escalation to CHIEF_INFORMATION_OFFICER.
